title: depcurfew policy
description: One supply-chain security policy for npm, pnpm, Yarn, Bun, Deno, uv, pip, Poetry, PDM, Pipenv, Renovate and Dependabot.

$schema.description: JSON Schema of this file, for editor support.

cooldown.description: Release-age delay (cooldown): freshly published versions wait before they are used.

minimum.description: Minimum age of a release before it is installed or proposed: a whole number followed by m (minutes), h (hours), d (days) or w (weeks). Converted to each tool's unit, always rounding up.

exclude.description: Packages that skip the release-age delay, e.g. your own scope.

items.description: An npm package name such as "esbuild" or "@scope/name", or a pattern with *, such as "@scope/*". Python packages take the prefix pypi:, e.g. "pypi:requests" or "pypi:acme-*". No versions.

securityUpdates.description: Whether security updates skip the delay ("bypass") or wait like other updates ("delay"), where the tool can tell them apart.

installScripts.description: Code that dependencies run when they are installed: lifecycle scripts in npm, building from source in Python.

default.description: Whether dependency lifecycle scripts (preinstall, install, postinstall) run by default; for Python, whether packages may be built from source.

allow.description: Packages whose lifecycle scripts may run when the default is "deny"; Python packages listed here are always built from source.

items.description: An npm package name such as "esbuild" or "@scope/name", or a pattern with *, such as "@scope/*". Python packages take the prefix pypi:, e.g. "pypi:requests" or "pypi:acme-*". No versions.

sources.description: Where dependencies may come from besides the registry. An absent field is not managed.

remoteTarball.description: Dependencies installed from tarball URLs outside the registry.

file.description: Dependencies installed from local tarball files.

targets.description: Tools to configure: "auto" detects them in the repository, or list them explicitly.

anyOf.description: Configure the tools detected in the repository.
